column2: # SQL query to find the number of small, medium, and large wildlife strikes per year
analysis_year_query <- "
SELECT YEAR(f.date) AS year,
SUM(CASE WHEN ws.wlsize = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS small_strikes,
SUM(CASE WHEN ws.wlsize = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS medium_strikes,
SUM(CASE WHEN ws.wlsize = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS large_strikes
FROM wildlife_strikes ws
JOIN flights f ON ws.fid = f.fid
GROUP BY year
ORDER BY year;
# Execute the query and store the results in a dataframe
results <- dbGetQuery(con, analysis_year_query)
# Remove rows with NA values
year_analysis <- na.omit(results)
# Display the results in a colorful, formatted table
year_analysis %>%
kable("html", col.names = c("Year", "Small Strikes", "Medium Strikes", "Large Strikes"), caption = "Wildlife Strikes by Size") %>%
kable_styling(full_width = FALSE, bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed", "responsive"), position = "center") %>%
row_spec(0, bold = TRUE, color = "white", background = "#4CAF50") %>%   # Header styling
column_spec(1, bold = TRUE, background = "#FFDDC1", color = "#A52A2A") %>% # Year column
column_spec(2, background = "#D4E157", color = "#33691E") %>%            # Small Strikes column
column_spec(3, background = "#FFD54F", color = "#FF6F00") %>%            # Medium Strikes column
column_spec(4, background = "#FF8A80", color = "#B71C1C")                # Large Strikes column
